svg.title: Containers and Kubernetes: Flask API, 5 replicas behind a LoadBalancer Service on Minikube
svg.desc: Two images published on Docker Hub (suriya4code/python-flask-microservice and suriya4code/flask-ocr) are pulled onto a Minikube node where a Deployment runs five replica pods of a Flask API behind a LoadBalancer Service; requests are spread across the pods. The same pattern maps to EKS and ECS at work.
svg.text: Flask API on Minikube behind a LoadBalancer · images on Docker Hub · same pattern as EKS / ECS at work
